summary: Produced the backend design artefact for OBS-06 at src/design/obs-06-alerting-hooks.md. The design defines configurable alerting hooks for instance ERROR duration, DLQ depth threshold crossing, and scheduler lag threshold breach; one-shot crossing and re-arm state semantics; deterministic payload contracts with correlation IDs; configuration schema including destination/auth/secret handling; bounded 3-attempt exponential-backoff delivery with OBS-01 terminal failure logging; idempotency safeguards; and explicit integration points with OBS-05, SCH-02, and EXT-02. A full traceability matrix maps all OBS-06 acceptance criteria and edge cases to implementation modules/functions and test obligations.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Validated all OBS-06 acceptance criteria and edge cases against explicit design sections for trigger semantics, payload contracts, retry/failure behavior, integrations, and traceability rows with module and test obligations.
